prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='FT_rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: FT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ONLY_CWT_catboost leads in seasonal capture (0.8688). CWT_rf dominates overall RMSE (47.66) with balanced early/late performance. High model disagreement (rmse_spread=31.6) and concept drift suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition structure while handling variance.
